mintAuthority.summary: A7A5 has two canonical native issuance deployments, on Ethereum and Tron. Old Vector LLC's minting and redemption run off-chain through KYC-gated authorized partners against RUB deposits; on-chain, the Ethereum token's issue() function is owned by a 3-of-5 custom multisig (5 EOA signers), and the Tron token's owner is a 3-of-5 Multisig contract (5 EOA signers). Both native tokens are direct immutable deployments with no proxy or other mint-logic upgrade path. Ethereum wA7A5 is a same-chain parent-backed representation and is excluded from Mint Authority; its lock/mint route is reviewed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Old Vector LLC issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated primary-market mint/redeem: Old Vector LLC creates A7A5 supply against custodied RUB bank deposits via KYC-verified partners (e.g. a7a5.kg); no on-chain permissionless mint exists.

controls.label: A7A5 ETH token owner (custom 3-of-5 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129 (2026-07-13), owner() on A7A5 Ethereum (0x6fa0be17e4bea2fcfa22ef89bf8ac9aab0ab0fc9) returns 0x7d2d47e441915ff9c2d5a6e4a7aadd5e02722e29. That contract has getOwners() returning the same 5 EOA addresses (0x6dab4c10..., 0xae8dd5dd..., 0x8b04bdc0..., 0x99d3df8c..., 0x3353d63a...) and getThreshold()=3. The token's EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots are zero; its exact-block runtime hash is 0x762de09de4267df1038313af242dd978f2835d193d90a51de836e808eae57dc9. No modules or guard were detected on the owner multisig.

controls.label: A7A5 Tron token owner (3-of-5 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Tron block 83506136 (2026-06-11): owner() on A7A5 Tron (TLeVfrdym8RoJreJ23dAGyfJDygRtiWKBZ) returns TML1DbrPXYDDwatGxw66iEwECnXCG54uJy, which is a Tron Multisig contract. getOwners() returns 5 owner hex addresses; getThreshold()=3. All 5 owner addresses resolve as non-contract EOAs on Tron.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129 (2026-07-13), the A7A5 token owner remains the custom 3-of-5 multisig with the same five EOA owners. The verified Ethereum source declares owner, compliance, and accountant as constructor-set immutable values, exposes no upgrade function, and the implementation and beacon slots are zero. On Tron, the independently deployed A7A5 runtime exposes the same direct token interface; Tronscan reports it fully verified and non-proxy, and opcode inspection of the 12,955-byte executable region found no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE, or SELFDESTRUCT path. The Tron owner was previously confirmed at block 83506136 as a 3-of-5 multisig with five EOA owners. The issuer-backend control cannot be independently confirmed from chain state, but both addressable on-chain mint surfaces and both immutable token runtimes are resolved. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No credible recurring independent reconciliation was located: Old Vector LLC publishes issuer-controlled transparency and an ad hoc reserve document, without a named independent attestor, stable cadence, or current liability reconciliation. Kyrgyz Finnadzor virtual-asset registration for Old Vector LLC is VASP/issuance status, not prudential reserve supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled multisigs can mint without a firm cap, no recurring whole-supply attestation is evidenced, and no prudential product supervisor is named. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Kreston's 4 July 2025 report independently reconciles Ethereum and Tron supply to reserves, establishing attestation-only supervision, but no second dated report was found to prove a recurring cadence. Boundary review 2026-08-16: Ethereum wA7A5 is a same-chain parent-backed wrapper, not a native issuance deployment; its conserved lock/mint route is authored under Bridge Risk. The proposed CEX transfer route between Ethereum and Tron remains unverified. ODR-A6 lane R reconciliation review 2026-09-01: two dated supply-to-reserve reports did exist in 2025 — a 'Financial figures and reserves report' as of 2025-03-31, press-attributed to Kreston Bishkek, and an 'OLD VECTOR LLC — Reserves Report and Independent Auditors' Report' as at 2025-07-04 whose auditor's report is signed 2025-09-26 under ISAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable assurance and reconciles total A7A5 supply of 12,025,177,081.90 tokens (Tron 11,514,405,217.87 plus Ethereum 510,771,864.03) to an identical RUB bank-account balance, with procedures that expressly verify management's reconciliation between the accounting ledger and the blockchain ledgers. Neither is reachable today: https://www.a7a5.io/audit.pdf returns a 500-byte React SPA HTML shell where it served application/pdf as late as the 2025-10-08 Wayback capture and had flipped to HTML by 2025-12-14; the March report URL is likewise dead; every probed later-quarter filename returns the same shell; docs.a7a5.io/legal/transparency is two sentences with no attestation, Kreston or reserve reference; the docs sitemap lists 24 pages with no attestation or reserve page, only a smart-contract audits page; and the live site JS bundle contains no occurrence of audit, attest, kreston, reserve or .pdf. Nothing is dated after 2025-07-04, so the brief 2025 cadence has lapsed and no reconciliation regime is published today. Kyrgyz Finnadzor's only public statement confirms the token registration and states that backing is managed by the issuer itself, disclosing no audit, attestation or verification duty. reconciliation is therefore recorded as the positively-established 'none' rather than left at the unverified 'unknown' (MINT-LADDER 9.32); no supply figure is taken from any of these documents into Pharos. One correction to the prior review: the letterhead of the July report OCRs as 'Anderson — Audit, Tax, Outsourcing, Consulting', not Kreston, so the single-firm attribution behind supervision 'attestation-only' is not safe and that field is left for a dedicated supervision pass rather than changed here.
